Core Algorithms in Log Space (SPEC Section 3) # ============================================================================== logsumexp <- function(x) { if (all(x == -Inf)) return(-Inf) m <- max(x) m + log(sum(exp(x - m))) } safe_log <- function(x) { out <- rep(-Inf, length(x)) pos <- x > 0 out[pos] <- log(x[pos]) if (!is.null(dim(x))) dim(out) <- dim(x) if (!is.null(dimnames(x))) dimnames(out) <- dimnames(x) out } #' Seeded Synthetic Patient Simulation (SPEC Section 4.2) simulate_patient <- function(T_len, seed, pi_vec = DEFAULT_PI, A_mat = DEFAULT_A, B_mat = DEFAULT_B) { validate_hmm(pi_vec, A_mat, B_mat) stopifnot(T_len >= 1) set.seed(as.integer(seed)) states <- integer(T_len) obs <- integer(T_len) states[1] <- sample.int(3, size = 1, prob = pi_vec) obs[1] <- sample.int(2, size = 1, prob = B_mat[states[1], ]) - 1L if (T_len >= 2) { for (t in 2:T_len) { states[t] <- sample.int(3, size = 1, prob = A_mat[states[t - 1], ]) obs[t] <- sample.int(2, size = 1, prob = B_mat[states[t], ]) - 1L } } list(states = states, obs = obs) } #' Log-Space Viterbi Algorithm (SPEC Section 3.1) #' Tie-breaking: which.max() deterministically selects the lowest state index. viterbi_log <- function(obs, pi_vec = DEFAULT_PI, A_mat = DEFAULT_A, B_mat = DEFAULT_B) { validate_hmm(pi_vec, A_mat, B_mat) T_len <- length(obs) stopifnot(T_len >= 1) log_pi <- safe_log(pi_vec) log_A <- safe_log(A_mat) log_B <- safe_log(B_mat) delta <- matrix(-Inf, nrow = T_len, ncol = 3, dimnames = list(paste0("t=", 1:T_len), STATE_NAMES)) psi <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = T_len, ncol = 3, dimnames = list(paste0("t=", 1:T_len), STATE_NAMES)) delta[1, ] <- log_pi + log_B[, obs[1] + 1L] if (T_len >= 2) { for (t in 2:T_len) { for (j in 1:3) { candidates <- delta[t - 1, ] + log_A[, j] best_i <- which.max(candidates) psi[t, j] <- best_i delta[t, j] <- candidates[best_i] + log_B[j, obs[t] + 1L] } } } best_log_prob <- max(delta[T_len, ]) if (!is.finite(best_log_prob)) { return(list(path = NULL, delta = delta, psi = psi, log_prob = -Inf)) } path <- integer(T_len) path[T_len] <- which.max(delta[T_len, ]) if (T_len >= 2) { for (t in (T_len - 1):1) { path[t] <- psi[t + 1, path[t + 1]] } } list(path = path, delta = delta, psi = psi, log_prob = best_log_prob) } #' Log-Space Forward Algorithm (SPEC Section 3.2) forward_log <- function(obs, pi_vec = DEFAULT_PI, A_mat = DEFAULT_A, B_mat = DEFAULT_B) { validate_hmm(pi_vec, A_mat, B_mat) T_len <- length(obs) stopifnot(T_len >= 1) log_pi <- safe_log(pi_vec) log_A <- safe_log(A_mat) log_B <- safe_log(B_mat) log_alpha <- matrix(-Inf, nrow = T_len, ncol = 3, dimnames = list(paste0("t=", 1:T_len), STATE_NAMES)) log_alpha[1, ] <- log_pi + log_B[, obs[1] + 1L] if (T_len >= 2) { for (t in 2:T_len) { for (j in 1:3) { log_alpha[t, j] <- log_B[j, obs[t] + 1L] + logsumexp(log_alpha[t - 1, ] + log_A[, j]) } } } ll <- logsumexp(log_alpha[T_len, ]) list( log_alpha = log_alpha, log_likelihood = ll, likelihood = if (is.finite(ll)) exp(ll) else 0 ) } fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 3) { ifelse(is.infinite(x), "-Inf", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)) } # ============================================================================== # 3.
